name: Learn cup-and-ball tricks
blurb: The oldest trick in magic, still one of the best. It teaches the whole foundation of sleight of hand: palming, loading, false transfers and misdirection.
gear: Three cups — proper magic cups or opaque plastic ones
steps: Learn to palm a ball invisibly with a relaxed hand.
Learn the false transfer, so a ball appears to move from one hand to the other.
Learn to load a ball secretly under a cup as you place it down.
Learn a basic three-phase routine: a ball penetrating a cup, balls travelling between cups, and a final production of larger objects.
Script it: the words, the pauses and where the audience is looking at each moment.
Rehearse in front of a mirror, then a camera, then live — the angles are unforgiving.
tips: This routine punishes bad angles more than almost any other. Learn where you can and cannot be watched from.
The final load — producing something impossibly large — is what people remember. Build the whole routine towards it.
proof: A full three-phase routine performed for a live audience with no flashes and no fumbles.
